component.name: ac3gui
component.summary: Forge — the AC3Forge encoder tools: clean-room AC-3 / E-AC-3 encoder, decoder and Dolby Atmos object-layer toolkit

description.p: ac3gui is the Qt6 front end for ac3forge, a clean-room implementation of the AC-3 and E-AC-3 (Dolby Digital / Dolby Digital Plus) audio codecs. It encodes and decodes both formats, including Dolby Atmos object-layer (OAMD/JOC) metadata and audio, and plays back an already-encoded stream directly.
